policy: verbatim copies of the import closure of Utils/Parameters.py, LearningAgents/DQNDiscreteAgent.py, TrainLearningAgent.py (A3, #128) and HeuristicAgents/PigShooter.py (E1, #132), plus the data files they read; the only edits rewrite absolute imports of the upstream top-level packages as package-relative imports; package markers added where upstream had none
runtime_notes: Upstream reads data files relative to the working directory (np.loadtxt('Utils/model'), open('Utils/target_class')); callers run with cwd = this vendor directory. Not edited.

Upstream pins torch 1.8.1 / torchvision 0.9.1; vendored unchanged and imported under torch 2.13 / torchvision in env b127-phyq. Compatibility observations are listed in 'compatibility' (no code edits).

compatibility.observation: deprecated since torchvision 0.13 but still accepted by torchvision 0.28.0; resolves to ResNet18_Weights.IMAGENET1K_V1 (resnet18-f37072fd.pth, sha256 f37072fd47e89c5e827621c5baffa7500819f7896bbacec160b1a16c560e07ec), tensor-identical (same keys, max abs diff 0.0) to torchvision 0.9.1's resnet18-5c106cde.pth (sha256 5c106cde386e87d4033832f2996f5493238eda96ccf559d1d62760c4de0613f8, data/external/phyq/)
torch >= 2.6 defaults to weights_only=True; state_dicts written by torch.save load unchanged
invalid escape sequence warning (DeprecationWarning) under Python 3.11; harmless

LearningAgents.RLNetwork.DQNRelationalSymbolic/DQNRelationalImage, LearningAgents.Memory, LearningAgents.DQNDiscreteAgent, Utils.Parameters, HeuristicAgents.PigShooter, TrainLearningAgent, SBEnvironment.SBEnvironmentWrapper and Client.agent_client import under torch 2.13.0+cu130 / torchvision 0.28.0+cu130 (conda env b127-phyq); both relational nets (h=120, w=160, outputs=180) give a [2, 180] output on CPU; 11,662,208 (symbolic) and 11,633,920 (image) parameters

use np.float, removed in NumPy 1.24; under numpy 2.4 (b127-phyq, novphy) they raise AttributeError. Callers set the removed alias (np.float = float, identical semantics) around the call; reported by the A3 adapter (PhyqA3). The PigShooter path (SymbolicStateDevReader) is unaffected (E1 smoke).

upstream_observations: DQNBase.train_model_memory: next_state_values[is_done_batch] = 0 indexes with a LongTensor (rows 0 and 1) rather than a boolean mask; kept verbatim (a port must reproduce or disclose it)

Utils/Parameters.py ships 'agent': 'ppo' (a string) and a CUDA device; TrainLearningAgent.py overrides num_update_steps to 80 // 5 (see .local-artifacts/issue-128-direct-predictors-v1/a3/harness-check.json)
HeuristicAgents/PigShooter.py samples its target pig and trajectory with the unseeded random module
